description:
Pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice putting Chandra, Acolyte of Flame onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Novice Pyromancer to your hand.
+0 Chandra, Acolyte of Flame creating 2 elemental tokens with haste.
Then pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice once again, putting Chandra, Novice Pyromancer onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Acolyte of Flame to your hand.
-1 Chandra adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
